perPixel.input: per-pixel features (raw; input standardisation baked into the ONNX)
perPixel.dataset: REAL - MARIDA + MADOS (Kikaki et al. 2022/2024), official train/val/test splits; GPU-trained on RTX 4050
perPixel.note: GPU-retrained per-pixel MLP with 4 engineered spectral indices (PI, MNDWI, red-edge NDVI, brightness) from the same 5 bands. Beats the prior numpy MLP on the identical held-out test: macroF1 0.500->0.787, accuracy 0.895->0.989, Sea_Foam precision 0.016->0.61, Plastic F1 0.508->0.749. Prior model kept as marinenet_prev.onnx; 7-feature drop-in alternative kept as marinenet_pp7.onnx.

dataset: REAL - MARIDA + MADOS (Kikaki et al. 2022/2024), official train/val/test splits (see perPixel.dataset for the shipped model)

patch.dataset: REAL - MARIDA + MADOS 64x64x6 patches (GPU-trained ResNet CNN)
patch.note: GPU-trained convolutional patch classifier. On the identical held-out test it UNDERPERFORMS the per-pixel model (macroF1 0.555 vs 0.787): 64x64 spatial context overfits the limited number of distinct scenes, while the per-pixel spectral signature generalises. Kept opt-in only via CNN_MODEL_PATH=models/marinenet_patch.onnx; NOT the default.

clay.model: clay_head.pt (frozen Clay v1.5 encoder + MLP head 1024-256-4)
clay.role: OPT-IN second stage / embedding layer — does NOT replace the per-pixel model
clay.note: Frozen pretrained backbone fixes the scene-overfitting that killed the from-scratch patch CNN (0.555): on identical held-out chips Clay head 0.711 > pp11-on-centres 0.690 > scratch CNN 0.555. On fully-new seas (RFO durban+marmara) Clay catches 2.4x the debris (recall 0.542 vs 0.222) at 7.6% water FP — the cross-domain generalization win. Runs offline in the mpt-train GPU env (backbone 4.8 GB, not shipped in the engine).

embeddingFeatures.note: Pure-numpy similarity over cached Clay embeddings powers find-similar, retrieval classification, few-shot, and novelty detection — engine-safe (no torch).

plpValidation.dataset: PLP 2021 (Topouzelis / Univ. Aegean) — deployed HDPE target + wood control

clayFusion.finding: At 64x64 chip scale (640m), the ~28m PLP target is sub-pixel-fraction: Clay plastic-affinity is 0.00 for BOTH the HDPE target and the wood control. Fusion never CONFIRMS a sub-chip point target (correctly refuses the wood false-positive too). Clay tier-2 adds value at PATCH scale, not for isolated tiny targets.

thresholds.calibratedOn: MARIDA+MADOS held-out test (aligned per-pixel MLP + Clay affinity)

rfoExperiment.dataset: RefinedFloatingObjects (Russwurm et al. 2023) — 6 scenes, 4689 refined points
rfoExperiment.result: Adding 3789 RFO px to MLP training LOST the primary MARIDA+MADOS benchmark (pp11_rfo 0.767 vs deployed 0.787) but nearly doubled debris recall on held-out NEW seas (0.409 vs 0.222 @ FP 1.5%). NOT promoted; kept as marinenet_pp{7,11}_rfo.onnx.
